cands.name: Anna Paulina Luna
cands.bio: Republican U.S. Representative since January 2023. Air Force and Air National Guard veteran (2009-2014); B.S. in biology, University of West Florida (2017). Lost to Charlie Crist in 2020; won in 2022 and 2024 (54.8%).
cands.local_ties: Born in Santa Ana, California; she and her husband bought a house in St. Petersburg in July 2020 (Wikipedia citing Washington Post).

record.text: Committees (119th Congress): Foreign Affairs and Oversight and Government Reform; led a House Oversight task force on declassification (JFK records, etc.). Chair of the El Salvador Caucus. Left the Freedom Caucus in 2025 after a proxy-voting dispute.

Sponsored the June 2023 censure of Rep. Adam Schiff (passed 213-209); pushed an inherent-contempt resolution against AG Merrick Garland in July 2024 (failed 204-210); co-sponsored a bill to ban congressional stock trading (H.R. 5106) and a 10% credit-card interest cap bill with Rep. Ocasio-Cortez.
Discharge petition on proxy voting for new parents (2025) led to a deal with Speaker Johnson in April 2025.

money_notes.text: Endorsed by Club for Growth PAC, AIPAC, Log Cabin Republicans and the Associated Builders and Contractors Florida Gulf Coast Chapter (per Wikipedia's 2026 election page).

controversies.text: Federal records show $10,000 from AIPAC's PAC since 2021; $15,240 from individuals passed through that PAC in 2025-26; 2 trips paid for by the American Israel Education Foundation, AIPAC's affiliate.
Missed 71 of 676 U.S. House votes this Congress (10.5%), counted from the roll calls through 2026-09-16. Longest run of misses: 16, 2026-05-20 to 2026-05-21.

Luna said in 2022 she was raised a Messianic Jew and is 'a small fraction Ashkenazi.' In 2023 the Washington Post reported relatives said her father was Catholic, and found no apparent Ashkenazi ancestry. Her mother said he embraced Messianic faith. Her office called the story 'comical.'

In July 2026 the Wall Street Journal reported that Luna told associates in 2024 she knew Trump's running mate, and allegedly tipped influencer Rogan O'Handley, who bet on Polymarket. A source said the CFTC is investigating. Luna denied it and filed a complaint alleging false reports to the CFTC. O'Handley denied it too.
2021: won a temporary stalking injunction against primary opponent William Braddock over a recorded threat; the judge later dismissed the permanent injunction.
Dec. 2025: amplified a false identification of a Palestinian student as the Brown University shooter (per NYT, cited on Wikipedia).

March 2026: hosted a Russian congressional delegation at the Capitol, drawing criticism from members of both parties. June 2026: her NDAA amendment summary, drafted by staff using Claude AI, was published with the phrase 'Claude responded.'

endorsements.text: Donald Trump; Rep. Berny Jacques (HD-59); Pinellas Commissioner Kathleen Peters; Club for Growth PAC; AIPAC; Log Cabin Republicans; Associated Builders and Contractors Florida Gulf Coast Chapter (per Wikipedia).
